title: Release of the MJ-12 documents

tellings.quote: So the MJ12 documents came out from 84. It was a string of documents ' 84 into the '90s.
but you have these majestic 12 document leaks from 1984 to the late 90s
tellings.difference: Names Vannevar Bush, Truman, Eisenhower and Bronk as figures in the documents.
tellings.link_reason: Both describe the MJ-12 documents coming out as a string of leaks from 1984 into the 1990s.

plain: Michels says a string of documents leaked from 1984 into the late 1990s describing Majestic 12, which in these papers is a secret group handling UFO matters. He says the papers name the scientists Vannevar Bush and Detlev Bronk and Presidents Harry Truman and Dwight Eisenhower, and he brings them up himself as a possible look inside a top-level UFO secret.
